description: A pack's manifest, at the root of the pack's directory, naming the pack and the systems, programs, variables and MCP servers it needs.

examples.description: Read and comment on pull requests, releases and git history.
examples.name: github

description.description: What the pack does, in one sentence. Must not be empty.

homepage.description: Where to read about the pack, such as its directory in the repository.

name.description: The pack's name, which installs it as `[packs.<name>]` and prefixes its items as `<name>__<kind>__<item>`. Lowercase letters, digits and single underscores, starting with a letter, at most 20 characters. `user`, `plan`, `agent`, `builtin`, `workbench` and `pack` are reserved.

requires.description: What the pack needs to run. `graph` and `os` are checked when the pack is installed or loaded, and a mismatch refuses it. `binaries`, `env` and `mcp` are reported by `graph config check`, and a plan run that reaches the pack fails before its first step when one is missing.

binaries.description: Programs the pack's tools run, which must be on `PATH`.

env.description: Environment variables the pack's tools read, which must be set and not empty, either in the environment or in the OS credential store.

graph.description: The graph versions the pack works with, as a semver requirement such as `">=0.15"`.

server.description: The name the server reports for itself.

url.description: The server's URL, shown in the error when no `[mcp.<name>]` is configured.

version.description: The server versions the pack works with, as a semver requirement.

mcp.description: MCP servers the pack's plans and agents call, as `[requires.mcp.<name>]`, where `<name>` is the `[mcp.<name>]` server their calls use, as in `<name>__<tool>`. `graph pack check` checks each call against the server when one is configured under that name.

os.description: The systems the pack runs on, `macos`, `linux` or both. `graph pack check` refuses a pack that leaves it empty.

version.description: The file version the manifest is written in. Omitted means 1.

title: pack.toml
x-locations: `<pack dir>/pack.toml`, such as `github/pack.toml` in a packs repository
